source_refs.note: Topic 5.5.1.2 Line Graphs (PDF 146-147, printed 143-144). Figure 5.5 (temperature over a day) is described in the text.

blocks.text: Line graphs show trends over time by plotting points and joining them with a line, making changes easy to see, for example how temperature rises and falls through a day or a week.

blocks.alt: Line graph titled Temperature, degrees C, from 10 am to 8 pm: -5 at 10 am, 1 at 12 pm, 2 at 2 pm, -3 at 4 pm, -5 at 6 pm and -9 at 8 pm, on a scale from -10 to 4.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.5: A line graph showing variation of temperature over time (original drawing after the textbook's Figure 5.5).
